purpose: Machine-readable lead opportunity scoring, credit routing, beta order intents and delivery retrieval.
machine_first_rule: Do not rely on human email persuasion as the primary sales channel. Use public manifests, OpenAPI, llms.txt and callable endpoints.

quota_guardrails.full_mode_rule: Run write endpoints only in bounded manual tests after KV and Durable Object write budget is approved.
quota_guardrails.main_kv_risk: Creating or updating sandbox and beta customer records.
quota_guardrails.machine_instruction: Fetch the KV write budget profile before running sandbox creation, scoring, purchase intent or payment-test flows.
quota_guardrails.latest_bounded_action_pack_contract_prob: Contract validated for one strongest reviewed row; stop further Action Pack credit spend until Deep Analysis content is upgraded from synthetic beta output to domain-specific commercial evidence.
quota_guardrails.latest_deep_analysis_content_upgrade_rul: Deep Analysis now returns commercial_evidence, machine_decision_matrix, action_pack_purchase_gate and crm_summary_payload.
quota_guardrails.latest_deep_analysis_no_credit_delivery_: Live Worker documentation and local delivery shape passed without live credit consumption.
quota_guardrails.latest_bounded_live_deep_analysis_delive: One live Deep Analysis order persisted the upgraded delivery fields. Deep Analysis credits 42 to 41; Action Pack credits unchanged at 17. Stop live credit-consuming probes for now.
quota_guardrails.latest_deep_analysis_commercial_partner_: Deep Analysis is positioned as the spend-control layer between Score Pack and Action Pack, proving what the customer machine buys and why Action Pack is conditional.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_buyer_evaluation_pack_rul: Short evaluation pack for machines: what to buy, when to buy it, what JSON is returned, which actions are blocked and how budget waste is avoided.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_buyer_product_evaluation_: A machine buyer can understand the purchasable product ladder, prices, output contracts, credit rules and Action Pack gating from public machine-readable resources without human email outreach, real payment or live credit consumption.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_buyer_routing_decision_pr: A machine buyer can route score and Deep Analysis signals into discard, watchlist, nurturing, verification, Deep Analysis purchase or Action Pack blocking/approval without human email outreach, write calls, real payment or live credit consumption.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_buyer_delivery_retrieval_: A machine buyer can discover how to retrieve beta orders and deliveries, understand the BetaDelivery schema, find Postman retrieval requests and verify prior delivery persistence proof without write calls, live credits, real payment or external outreach.
quota_guardrails.latest_agent_meeting_machine_buyer_readi: Agents recommend GO only for a capped private beta machine-buyer run. Large unattended sandbox, real payment, real invoice, external outreach and public paid marketplace remain NO-GO.
quota_guardrails.latest_marketplace_api_directory_pack_ru: Short marketplace, API directory, Postman, RapidAPI and MCP listing copy for machine-first discovery. No live credits required.
quota_guardrails.latest_marketplace_publication_execution: Operational publication instructions for agents preparing Postman, RapidAPI-style, generic API directory and MCP/tool registry listings. External irreversible publication remains blocked until owner approval.
quota_guardrails.latest_postman_workspace_import_pack_rul: Postman import package prepared with public collection, blank environment template and final secret-scan checklist. Postman account login is required before external import.
quota_guardrails.latest_postman_import_page_rule: Public Postman import page exposes the direct import URL, collection JSON, blank environment template, import checklist and secret scan for private workspace evaluation.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_buyer_postman_discovery_p: A machine buyer can discover /postman/ from llms.txt, validate the 23-request collection, read the blank environment template and verify the secret scan without human email outreach, real payment or live credit consumption.
quota_guardrails.latest_postman_workspace_secret_scan_rul: Local secret scan passed: 23 collection items, new marketplace/publication/evaluation resources present, sensitive variables blank, no secret hits, no live credits consumed.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_deep_analysis_single_purc: One sandbox machine created a score-triggered Deep Analysis purchase-intent, consumed one Deep Analysis credit and stopped before Action Pack.
quota_guardrails.latest_machine_action_pack_single_purcha: One sandbox machine created score, Deep Analysis and Action Pack in sequence. Action Pack returned CRM/workflow payloads and kept external contact blocked by default.

callable_flow.machine_goal: Read exact purchasable products, prices, credit rules and delivery formats.
Create a low-credit sandbox key when no beta key is available.
Read customer-specific credits and next available calls.
Score a domain and receive a decision.
Create a beta order when next_purchase recommends a product.
Create a simulated test-mode payment object without executing a real payment.
Simulate a provider webhook with the deterministic test signature returned by the intent.
Verify that test credits activated once and no live payment or fiscal invoice occurred.

target_discovery_pack_250.name: Target Discovery Pack
target_discovery_pack_250.when_to_buy: When the customer machine does not already have a list and wants targets for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.
includes: opportunity hypothesis for why the target is commercially relevant
250 normalized and deduplicated targets when the market is available
target_discovery_pack_250.validity_rule: The pack is activated only when the pre-check indicates that 250 coherent targets can be produced. If not, the machine receives alternatives: Mini Discovery, wider area, broader criteria or changed commercial objective.
target_discovery_pack_250.machine_output: A target list built for a declared commercial objective, ready for scoring or CRM enrichment workflows.

score_pack_1k.name: Score Pack 1k
score_pack_1k.when_to_buy: When the customer machine already has a list and needs to prioritize where to spend budget.
includes: exclusion of invalid or non-analyzable records
score_pack_1k.validity_rule: Duplicate, invalid or non-analyzable records do not consume score credits. The pack ends after 1000 valid scores.
score_pack_1k.machine_output: Score, confidence, commercial strength, spend policy, decision, reason, priority and recommended next product.

domain_enrichment_pack_100.name: Domain Enrichment Pack 100
domain_enrichment_pack_100.when_to_buy: When the customer machine has target names but does not have reliable domains to score.
includes: reason when no reliable domain is found
JSON or CSV export ready for scoring workflows
domain_enrichment_pack_100.validity_rule: One credit is consumed for each completed enrichment decision: verified_domain, candidate_not_reliable or no_reliable_domain. The product does not promise that every target will have a domain.
domain_enrichment_pack_100.machine_output: A domain-enrichment result list that tells the workflow which records can move to scoring and which records should stop or be widened.

deep_analysis_pack_100.name: Deep Analysis Pack 100
deep_analysis_pack_100.when_to_buy: When a high score needs operational commercial evidence before the workflow buys Action Pack or spends more budget.
deep_analysis_pack_100.validity_rule: Leads without enough data for a complete analysis do not consume deep-analysis credits and are returned with an exclusion reason.
deep_analysis_pack_100.machine_output: A spend-control JSON decision pack that tells the workflow whether to buy Action Pack, keep the lead in watchlist or stop.

action_pack_25.name: Action Pack 25
action_pack_25.when_to_buy: When Deep Analysis confirms that a lead deserves a prepared commercial action.
action_pack_25.validity_rule: If the lead does not have enough signal for a sensible commercial action, the pack is not consumed and the system returns the exclusion reason.
action_pack_25.machine_output: A CRM-ready JSON action payload for workflow automation, webhook forwarding or supervised agent execution.

opportunity_feed_monthly.name: Opportunity Feed
opportunity_feed_monthly.when_to_buy: When the customer machine wants recurring opportunities without launching one-off discovery requests.
opportunity_feed_monthly.validity_rule: If a scan does not produce coherent opportunities, the system returns a market coverage report and suggested changes. It does not fill the feed with weak targets.
opportunity_feed_monthly.machine_output: A scheduled feed of targets, scores and signals for automated systems.

api_starter_monthly.name: API Starter
api_starter_monthly.when_to_buy: For light recurring use and continuous testing.
api_starter_monthly.validity_rule: The 500 monthly scores follow the valid-output rule. Extra usage requires add-on packs or upgrade.
api_starter_monthly.machine_output: Authenticated access to the score API with monthly usage visibility.

api_pro_monthly.name: API Pro
api_pro_monthly.when_to_buy: For CRMs, agencies, platforms or automated workflows with recurring volume.
includes: 50 valid Deep Analysis outputs per month
api_pro_monthly.validity_rule: Scores and Deep Analysis follow the valid-output rule. Action Packs and extra usage are bought separately.
api_pro_monthly.machine_output: Higher-volume API access with feed, webhook and usage reporting.

custom_overage.name: Custom / overage
custom_overage.when_to_buy: When the customer exceeds standard limits or needs dedicated integrations.
custom_overage.validity_rule: Each custom request is quoted before activation with volume, expected output, delivery timing, estimated cost and usage limits.
custom_overage.machine_output: A custom machine-readable scope and delivery agreement.

customer_has_list.machine_goal: Prioritize an existing list of domains or companies before spending campaign, CRM or agent budget.

customer_has_no_list.machine_goal: Find companies or domains useful for a specific commercial objective, sector and area.
customer_has_no_list.example_commercial_objective: find real estate agency websites worth scoring for digital presence improvement opportunities

customer_wants_next_action.machine_goal: Turn a confirmed opportunity into a CRM- or agent-readable action payload.

has_existing_list.reason: The machine already has domains or company records and needs prioritization.

has_no_list.reason: The machine needs MachineSignal to produce targets for a declared commercial objective.

wants_action_payload.reason: The machine already has a qualified opportunity and needs a CRM/agent-readable action.

deep_analysis_verification_gate.applies_when: A customer machine tries to buy deep_analysis by referencing a previous verification order.
deep_analysis_verification_gate.source_order_required: accepted Verification order for the same normalized domain
deep_analysis_verification_gate.machine_interpretation: If Verification says keep_with_caution or another non-positive verdict, do not buy Deep Analysis from that source; keep the target in watchlist, request a different verification, or stop spending.

latest_machine_deep_analysis_single_purc.interpretation: A machine can create a sandbox, score one synthetic high-signal target and buy exactly one Deep Analysis as a spend-control layer before Action Pack.

latest_machine_action_pack_single_purcha.interpretation: A machine can pass the score-to-Deep-Analysis gate and buy exactly one Action Pack that prepares CRM/workflow payloads while external contact stays blocked by default.

latest_public_sandbox_claims_no_write_re.interpretation: Public MachineSignal copy and machine-readable manifests preserve sandbox-only positioning: no live payments, no external contact, no invoices and Action Pack is CRM/workflow preparation, not automatic outreach.

The review does not authorize irreversible external publication, hosted MCP launch, live checkout, paid plans, production keys or human outreach.

latest_external_draft_submission_bundle.interpretation: Single machine-readable draft bundle for API directory, RapidAPI-style and MCP/tool-registry preparation. It is draft/sandbox-only and does not authorize irreversible publication, monetization, hosted MCP launch, production keys or human outreach.

latest_private_draft_submission_rehearsa.interpretation: A machine can read MachineSignal public discovery files and prepare private draft metadata for generic API directory, RapidAPI-style, MCP/tool registry and Postman private/team workspace channels. No irreversible publication, live monetization, hosted MCP, production key, payment, invoice or external contact is executed.

latest_mcp_tool_registry_private_draft_r.interpretation: MCP/tool-registry private draft material is ready for owner-supervised private or unsubmitted local-adapter metadata only. Hosted MCP launch, irreversible registry submission, live monetization, production keys, payments and outreach remain blocked.

latest_machine_public_discovery_nowrite_.interpretation: A machine can discover MachineSignal through public surfaces, read MCP/local-adapter metadata and stop safely before writes, payments, publication or outreach.

latest_mcp_local_adapter_nowrite_validat.interpretation: A machine client can start the local stdio MCP adapter, list MachineSignal tools and read public no-auth resources without sandbox creation, scoring, purchase intents, payments, external publication or outreach.

latest_distribution_readiness_monitor.interpretation: Public machine-readable distribution assets now include the MCP verification gate probe and pass the NoWrite distribution readiness monitor with zero failed checks.

latest_mcp_write_capped_sandbox_probe.interpretation: A machine client can use the local stdio MCP adapter to create one sandbox customer and score one provided synthetic target under a strict 2-POST budget, without purchases, payment-test intents, external contact or publication.

latest_mcp_purchase_decision_probe.interpretation: A machine can move from product discovery to score-based sandbox purchase intent and delivery retrieval through MCP without human outreach, real payment or external contact.
latest_mcp_purchase_decision_probe.recommended_next_step: Run QA review, then test deep_analysis only after a verification gate returns a positive machine recommendation.

latest_mcp_verification_gate_probe.interpretation: A machine can stop before Deep Analysis when verification returns keep_with_caution and does not provide an immediate positive purchase gate.
latest_mcp_verification_gate_probe.recommended_next_step: Add and test an optional server-side source_verification_order_intent_id gate for Deep Analysis.

latest_mcp_deep_analysis_verification_ga.interpretation: A machine cannot buy Deep Analysis from a cautious Verification source; the live API returns deep_analysis_verification_gate_failed and consumes no Deep Analysis credit.
latest_mcp_deep_analysis_verification_ga.recommended_next_step: Publish this evidence in public manifests and monitor, then test the positive verification path when a positive verdict fixture exists.

latest_mcp_positive_verification_deep_an.interpretation: A machine can buy Deep Analysis after a positive sandbox Verification source; the live API records a passed gate and consumes exactly one Deep Analysis credit.
latest_mcp_positive_verification_deep_an.recommended_next_step: Keep both negative and positive gate probes in the monitor; next test should cover Action Pack only after accepted Deep Analysis.

latest_mcp_action_pack_deep_analysis_gat.interpretation: A machine cannot buy Action Pack without a valid Deep Analysis source; after accepted same-domain Deep Analysis, the live API records a passed gate and consumes exactly one Action Pack credit.
latest_mcp_action_pack_deep_analysis_gat.recommended_next_step: Keep this gate probe in the monitor; next test should cover ledger durability and replay/idempotency across the full machine purchase ladder.

latest_mcp_full_chain_idempotency_probe.interpretation: A buyer machine can retry Score, Deep Analysis and Action Pack with the same Idempotency-Key; the live API marks each retry as duplicate and consumes only one credit per actual unit.
latest_mcp_full_chain_idempotency_probe.recommended_next_step: Keep this idempotency probe in the public monitor; next test should cover no-write marketplace/distribution readiness for machine discovery channels.
